pyongyang.title: Seoul to maintain Ukraine aid despite spat over North Korea prisoner transfer
detail: South Korea will continue supporting Ukraine “as a responsible member of the international community” despite a diplomatic dispute over the disclosure of two North Korean prisoners of war being repatriated to the South, a foreign ministry official said on Thursday. (South China Morning Post)

pyongyang.title: North Korea test-fires submarine-launched cruise missiles amid rising tensions
detail: North Korea test-fired two types of submarine-launched strategic cruise missiles on Wednesday, state media KCNA reported Thursday, saying the launches posed no threat to neighbouring countries. (France 24)
North Korean state media said the military test-fired cruise missiles designed to be launched from submarines. Pyongyang has ramped up weapons launches in recent weeks. (DW)

pyongyang.title: China-North Korea border bridge opens
detail: The long-delayed bridge will formally open on Thursday, according to China's state-run Xinhua news agency. (Al Jazeera)

A bridge between China and North Korea that was completed 12 years ago will finally open on Thursday. The two countries will hold an opening ceremony to mark the official opening of the New Yalu River Bridge, Chinese state news agency Xinhua reported on Wednesday morning. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Singapore targets 7 companies over wildfires in Indonesia as toxic haze worsens
detail: Singapore has identified seven companies it says were involved in wildfires in Indonesia that are choking the city state with haze, and plans to issue notices requiring them to take preventive measures, the Business Times reported. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Haze-hit Singapore parents call for Hong Kong-style school air con
detail: Salon manager Alice Pang says her 10-year-old daughter has likened the visibility inside her classroom in Singapore to Malaysia’s Genting Highlands, but while the mountain resort is often shrouded in fog caused by water particles, her child’s active imagination may have been triggered by worsening haze plaguing the… (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Indonesian governor’s Singapore trip adds fury to forest fire, haze crisis
detail: The governor of an Indonesian province bearing the brunt of weeks of raging forest fires has sought to douse anger over his trip to Singapore, as Jakarta “welcomed” help from its neighbours choked by transboundary haze to contain the crisis. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Singapore probing firms over haze-causing Indonesian fires
detail: Singapore’s Prime Minister Lawrence Wong vowed to identify companies that may be responsible for the fires shrouding the city-state in haze for weeks, warning that those found culpable could face legal action. (Bloomberg)
The city-state and neighboring Malaysia have been blanketed for weeks by toxic smog from a severe wildfire season in Indonesia. (The Japan Times)

singapore.title: Indonesia's skies turn apocalyptic orange as smoke blankets Singapore
detail: Apocalyptic orange skies engulf Palangkaraya in Indonesia, while Singapore's famous Marina Bay Sands nearly disappears behind thick smoke. Months of wildfires have triggered an air pollution crisis across Southeast Asia. (Euronews)

singapore.title: Canada, Singapore reaffirm China trade ties amid global push for self-sufficiency
detail: Canada and Singapore are among the countries that remain committed to strengthening trade ties with China, despite growing global fragmentation and a push by governments towards greater self-sufficiency, officials from both countries said on Wednesday at an economic forum in New Delhi. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay holds talks with Singapore Deputy PM on economic ties, investments
detail: The meeting was held on the sidelines of the unveiling of the Singapore-based CapitaLand Data Centre Chennai 01 at SIDCO Industrial Estate in Ambattur (The Hindu)

singapore.title: Hong Kong teenager pleads guilty to acid attack on Singaporean tourist
detail: A 19-year-old teenager has admitted splashing corrosive liquid on a Singaporean tourist in Hong Kong last year, leaving her with second-degree burns. (South China Morning Post)

wellington.title: Museum releases historical photos of island where Amelia Earhart may have crashed
detail: Images from New Zealand aerial survey of Nikumaroro in 1938 offer new clues over aviator’s disappearance A New Zealand museum has released nearly 50 photos from a 1938 aerial survey of the island where Amelia Earhart is believed to have crash-landed, offering amateur sleuths new evidence to scour for traces of the… (The Guardian)

wellington.title: Net Migration From New Zealand to Australia Hits Highest Level Since 2013
detail: New Zealand’s exodus of citizens to Australia accelerated in the first three months of the year, reaching the highest in 13 years in a further blow to the government just weeks from an election, latest data show. (Bloomberg)

kathmandu.title: Flash floods destroy villages in central Nepal
detail: Landslide blocks river and triggers downstream flooding, while summer temperatures persist in Portugal Flash floods have swept through Nepal’s central Gorkha district after a pre-dawn landslide on 11 October blocked the Budhi Gandaki River, triggering severe downstream flooding. (The Guardian)

kathmandu.title: Inside Nepal’s unending cycle of avalanches, floods and landslides
detail: Nepal has weathered three disasters in six weeks, including the deadly August flash flood, making this year one of the deadliest in a country where monsoon rains already frequently wreak havoc. Experts warn that climate change is only making matters worse. (South China Morning Post)

kathmandu.title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats
detail: Can Nepal bring the two regional giants together to confront a shared climate threat in the Himalayas? (BBC News)

kathmandu.title: Nepal travel agents threaten to halt Thailand trips over visa rules
detail: KATHMANDU — Nepal’s travel agents are threatening to stop selling trips to Thailand unless the country eases visa procedures that leave Nepali travelers exposed to potentially heavy financial losses. (Inquirer)

kathmandu.title: Smart economics: tackle climate change and air pollution together
detail: Indonesia continues to battle some of its worst wildfires in years, spreading toxic haze to Malaysia and Singapore. Floods have devastated communities in Thailand, India and Nepal. Kathmandu is also seeking climate justice after a catastrophic collapse of rock and glacier ice near its border with China. (South China Morning Post)

kathmandu.title: How a detour saved a Malaysian trekker from jaws of deadly Nepal floods
detail: It was a detour that saved his life. Malaysian Low Hock Meng, a 71-year-old veteran trekker, had set off on his own in Nepal. He wanted to explore the Tamang trail, Langtang Valley and Gosaikunda. Along his journey, he made the decision to visit the Nagathali viewpoint for a glimpse of Tibet on August 25. (South China Morning Post)

kathmandu.title: More than 100 foreign trekkers stranded by floods in Nepal’s Gorkha region
detail: Hundreds were rescued after the flooding of a river in central Nepal over the weekend swept away hiking trails and bridges. (The Japan Times)
Rescue operation underway after flash floods swept away homes, bridges and parts of the Manaslu trekking trail. (Al Jazeera)

kathmandu.title: Torrent of mud, rocks engulfs settlements along Nepal river
detail: Hotelier Sherap Gurung of Lokpa, the gateway village and permit checkpoint for the popular Tsum Valley trekking area in northern Gorkha district, woke early on Sunday to a growing rumble from the Syarkhola stream below his house. (Inquirer)

nuuk.title: Trump says 'massive' oil, gas and mineral exploration to begin in Greenland
detail: Donald Trump says that preparations are underway to launch a "massive" oil, gas ‌and mineral exploration in Greenland. (Sky News)

US President Donald Trump said on Wednesday that a "massive" oil, gas and mineral exploration was slated to begin in Greenland. The US, Denmark and Greenland last month signed a security agreement after Trump's repeated threats to seize control of the island. (France 24)
